purpose: Canonical evidence file for 2021. Only sourced records in this file are eligible for later card scoring.

records.title: Tesla discloses $1.5 billion Bitcoin purchase
records.summary: Tesla's 2020 Form 10-K disclosed that after changing its investment policy in January 2021, the company invested an aggregate $1.5 billion in Bitcoin.
records.significance: One of the world's most valuable public companies adding Bitcoin to its treasury was a watershed institutional-adoption moment.

records.title: Beeple NFT sells for $69.3 million at Christie's
records.summary: Christie's sold Beeple's Everydays: The First 5000 Days for $69,346,250 in a single-lot online auction.
records.significance: The sale moved NFTs from crypto-native markets into the highest tier of the traditional art world and became the defining mainstream NFT price milestone.

records.title: Coinbase lists directly on Nasdaq
records.summary: Coinbase began trading on Nasdaq under ticker COIN through a direct listing on 14 April 2021.
records.significance: The listing brought a major crypto-native exchange into US public equity markets and gave mainstream investors direct exposure to a crypto infrastructure company.

records.title: Bored Ape Yacht Club launches
records.summary: Yuga Labs says BAYC launched with a week-long presale on 23 April 2021 at 0.08 ETH per Ape and sold out on 1 May.
records.significance: BAYC became the defining membership/PFP NFT brand of the 2021 boom and helped turn NFT ownership into online identity, community access and IP culture.

sources.title: Yuga Labs — Let's Make A NFT

records.title: Uniswap v3 launches
records.summary: Uniswap v3 deployed to Ethereum mainnet with concentrated liquidity and redesigned liquidity-position mechanics.
records.significance: Concentrated liquidity materially increased AMM capital efficiency and became one of DeFi's most influential market-design innovations.

records.title: China signals nationwide Bitcoin mining crackdown
records.summary: China's Financial Stability and Development Committee called for cracking down on Bitcoin mining and trading activities, escalating prior restrictions to mining itself.
records.significance: The crackdown forced a rapid geographic redistribution of Bitcoin hash power away from China and permanently changed the global mining map.

sources.title: State Council Information Office/Xinhua — China doubles down on virtual currency regulation

records.title: El Salvador passes the Bitcoin Law
records.summary: El Salvador's Legislative Assembly approved Decree 57, the Bitcoin Law, recognizing Bitcoin as legal tender.
records.significance: El Salvador became the first sovereign state to adopt Bitcoin as legal tender, moving the asset from private monetary experiment into national law.

sources.title: El Salvador Legislative Assembly — Bitcoin Law approval

records.title: Axie Infinity explodes into mass play-to-earn adoption
records.summary: Axie reported 800,000 daily active users in July after passing 250,000 in June, alongside surging marketplace volume and protocol revenue.
records.significance: Axie's 2021 growth made play-to-earn a global crypto narrative and demonstrated that NFT economies could attract hundreds of thousands of daily players.

records.title: Ethereum London upgrade activates EIP-1559
records.summary: Ethereum's London upgrade activated at block 12,965,000 and introduced EIP-1559's base-fee burn mechanism and new fee-market design.
records.significance: EIP-1559 fundamentally changed Ethereum transaction pricing and ETH monetary economics by burning a portion of transaction fees.

records.title: Poly Network suffers $612 million exploit
records.summary: An attacker exploited Poly Network's cross-chain smart contracts and stole about $612 million across multiple networks, then began returning most of the funds the next day.
records.significance: At the time it was the largest DeFi theft and became uniquely famous because the attacker communicated on-chain and returned the overwhelming majority of the assets.

records.title: Arbitrum One launches publicly
records.summary: Arbitrum One opened publicly on 31 August 2021 as a production optimistic-rollup network for Ethereum.
records.significance: Arbitrum became one of Ethereum's largest layer-2 systems and helped make rollups the dominant scaling path for the ecosystem.

sources.title: Arbitrum — Stylus mainnet post referencing Arbitrum One public launch

records.title: El Salvador Bitcoin legal-tender regime takes effect
records.summary: El Salvador's Bitcoin Law took effect on 7 September 2021, giving Bitcoin official-currency/legal-tender status alongside the US dollar.
records.significance: This was the operational start of the world's first national Bitcoin legal-tender experiment.

sources.title: IMF — El Salvador 2021 Article IV informational annex

relationships.title: El Salvador passes the Bitcoin Law

records.title: Solana network goes offline for 17 hours
records.summary: Solana's Mainnet Beta stopped confirming blocks for about 17 hours after bot-driven transaction volume caused memory exhaustion and validator crashes; validators coordinated a restart.
records.significance: The outage became the most famous early reliability failure of a fast-growing high-throughput L1 and a recurring reference point in Solana decentralization debates.

sources.title: Solana Foundation — 9-14 Network Outage Initial Overview

records.title: China declares virtual-currency business activities illegal
records.summary: China's central bank and multiple agencies stated that virtual-currency-related business activities constituted illegal financial activity and strengthened enforcement against trading and overseas exchange services to Chinese residents.
records.significance: The notice completed one of the world's most comprehensive national crackdowns on crypto trading after the mining crackdown earlier that year.

sources.title: People's Bank of China — virtual currency risk notice

records.title: First US Bitcoin futures ETF begins trading
records.summary: ProShares BITO launched on 19 October 2021 as the first US Bitcoin-linked ETF, gaining exposure through regulated Bitcoin futures rather than spot Bitcoin.
records.significance: The product broke a long US ETF barrier and opened Bitcoin-linked exposure through ordinary brokerage accounts.

records.title: Ethereum Altair upgrade activates
records.summary: Altair activated at Beacon Chain epoch 74,240, adding sync committees and adjusting validator incentives and penalties.
records.significance: Altair was the first scheduled upgrade to Ethereum's Beacon Chain and an important technical step toward the Merge.

records.title: Bitcoin reaches roughly $68,950 all-time high
records.summary: CoinDesk's Bitcoin price data recorded a new all-time high of about $68,950 on 10 November 2021.
records.significance: The peak capped the 2020-2021 bull cycle before the market turned into the 2022 collapse cycle.
records.notes: Use source/index-specific wording; there was no single universal spot price across all exchanges.

records.title: Optimism soft-launches OP Mainnet
records.summary: Optimism's protocol specification dates the OP Mainnet soft launch to 16 January 2021; permissionless application deployment came later in the year.
records.significance: Optimism was among the first production optimistic rollups and helped establish Ethereum's rollup-centric scaling path.
